description: Source code for chat controller handling chat state, message sending, receiving, and event processing in a client-side application.

methods.name: isSilentReplyStream
methods.description: Checks if the given text matches the NO_REPLY pattern indicating a silent reply.

methods.name: isAssistantSilentReply
methods.description: Detects if a message from the assistant is a silent reply (NO_REPLY).

methods.name: maybeResetToolStream
methods.description: Resets the tool stream if certain stream-related properties are present in the state.

methods.name: loadChatHistory
methods.description: Loads chat history from the server, filtering out silent assistant replies.

methods.name: dataUrlToBase64
methods.description: Converts a data URL to a base64 content and MIME type.

methods.name: normalizeAssistantMessage
methods.description: Normalizes assistant messages based on role and content options.

methods.name: normalizeAbortedAssistantMessage
methods.description: Normalizes an aborted assistant message, requiring role and content array.

methods.name: normalizeFinalAssistantMessage
methods.description: Normalizes a final assistant message, allowing optional role and text content.

methods.name: sendChatMessage
methods.description: Sends a chat message with optional attachments, updates chat state, handles errors.

methods.name: abortChatRun
methods.description: Aborts the current chat run via the client request.

methods.name: handleChatEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming chat events, updating chat messages and state accordingly.
